content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Akron

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-leadership experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Document your education and project hours—roles across Advanced Manufacturing, Healthcare Systems, Engineering & Construction, and other sectors all count. Verify you meet PMI's baseline before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, covering the PMBOK Guide, exam domains, and real-world applications. All coursework is delivered online nationwide; you'll earn the required contact hours from your home or office in Akron.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and answer eligibility questions before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, review sessions, and study guides—to strengthen weak domains. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. You may test at an authorized testing center or online from Akron, depending on your preference.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and workshops. Renew your PMP before expiration by submitting proof of continued learning to PMI.
